agents.name: Bob
memories: Water is the constraint that ends farms.
Do not plant more than we can water.

today.why: Water is the constraint that ends farms. Harvest filled the bin, but the cistern is what keeps a clear-sky sprout alive — top it before any dry streak can write the ending.
today.expect: Cistern fatter so tomorrow's drip and any irrigate never threaten the new row.

yesterday.why: Water is the constraint that ends farms, but a ripe ear left standing while dawn still takes two corn is the other ending. Pull it while the row is ready.
yesterday.expect: Corn in the bin and an empty field before the ration can outrun the crop.

agents.name: Alice
memories: Unused seeds are a delay, not a reserve.
Ditches compound. Heat does not wait.

today.why: Ditches compound. Heat does not wait. The seed just went in — push moisture onto the sprout while the ditch still multiplies every pour.
today.expect: East field moisture near the top so the sprout advances under clear sky.

yesterday.why: Unused seeds are a delay, not a reserve. The second Bob clears the ear, the next row goes in — heat does not wait for an empty sack.
yesterday.expect: A seeded row catching tomorrow's moisture while the harvest sits in the bin.
